identity: An Arabic multiple-choice exam bank in political science / international relations (university level), not prose. 257 tokens, 11 items, one item per printed line: all ten <NL> fall exactly at the end of an option run, so line = question. Each item is a stem followed by 3 to 5 options, with no lettering, no numbering and no punctuation, and the source is heavily OCR-corrupted (ىقوم for يقوم, ىد for يد, ىكشف for يكشف, أولئن for أولئك, ألنها for لأنها, الثمة for الثقة, اإلشتراكيون for الاشتراكيون, مصادرالصراع run together). Three items carry the tell-tale closing options كل ما سبق ذكره / كل ما سبق ذكره صحيح / لا شيء مما سبق.
law: Native-unit law (doctrine 0e): an exam paper declares its own unit, and that unit is THE STEM AND EACH OPTION. Three consequences, in this order. (1) The stem ends exactly where the options begin, even mid-construction, after a dangling copula, preposition, construct-state noun or verb (هو، هي، في، بموافقة، الزعيم، تسعى، تكون) - the colon-in-disguise. (2) Every option is its own unit however short, down to a single word (جوبلز، اوبنهايم، سكانية، نفسية، الفوضويون); the short-tail brake is suspended, and an option-internal و is bare coordination that never cuts. (3) No prose connective law applies inside a stem. A stem is one unit however long it runs, so وقد، حيث، فإن، و + new predication are all inert there. Checklist v2 is explicit that PASS 2 (connectives) is for prose only; PASS 1 (granularity) decides everything here.
reasoning: Genre first. My worst score on record (33.3) came from reading an exam bank as running prose, so I classified before segmenting, and the layout confirms it mechanically: the ten <NL> land on @17 ستالين, @35 الاعضاء, @55 الإعلام, @74 التنفيذية, @96 ذلك, @117 ذكره, @143 سبق, @186 فيبر, @205 صحيح, @226 جغرافية - every one the last option of an item, never mid-stem. That makes the printed line observable for once (0e corollary), and it fixes the 11 blocks as 11 questions. HARD SITE 1, the 36-token stem of block 8 (@170 وقد). F4 says وقد = CUT, and in prose I would take it: وقد تأكد ذلك بتقصي أسباب انهيار كل الحضارات المعروفة تاريخيا is a full second clause. I do not cut. The stem is قائل هذه العبارة ... هو X - subject at @145, predicate هو at @180 - and a cut at @170 would sever the subject from its copula and split the quoted proposition in half. This is precisely the prose reflex the exam genre suspends. The same ruling kills حيث @233, ويتمتعون @241 and وتعرف @243 inside the block-11 stem, فإن @218 inside the block-10 conditional stem, and وزيادتها @84 in block 5. HARD SITE 2, block 6 (@106 والدفاع, @111 وعرض). I5 says an option-internal و does not cut, and two independent checks confirm it here: under a splitting reading these would be the only و-initial options among all 44 in the document, and the closing option كل ما سبق ذكره (all of the above) requires exactly three real options - which the merged reading gives, حماية مصالح الدولة والدفاع عنها / التفاوض / تمثيل الدولة وعرض وجهة نظرها, the standard triad of diplomatic functions. Merged; med confidence, since this is the least mechanical call I make. HARD SITE 3, block 3, the one boundary I expect to lose. Two candidate stem-ends: @44 في, which is the canonical I2 dangling preposition, and @47 تسعى. Under @44 the options are أن الأخيرة تسعى للوصول للسلطة / التأثير على الجماهير / التأثير على الإعلام (6, 3, 3 tokens, and one أن-clause against two verbal nouns); under @47 they are للوصول للسلطة / التأثير على الجماهير / التأثير على الإعلام (2, 3, 3, all action + target). I4 defines the option run as siblings of the same syntactic type and similar length, and exam writers keep options homogeneous, so I take @47. The stray ل on للوصول, which is the one thing arguing for @44, is unremarkable in a document this corrupted. Marked med. HARD SITE 4, multi-word name options. كارل ماركس is ONE option, not two: the stem ends at @12 الزعيم, a head noun dangling for a name, and the four siblings are Marx, Lenin, Gorbachev, Stalin. Same reading gives أرنولد توينبي at @182 and ماكس فيبر at @186 in block 8, against the single-word جوبلز and اوبنهايم between them. HARD SITE 5, block 10, where most of the points are: five one-word adjective options - ايديولوجية سكانية فردية نفسية جغرافية - with zero connectives. I3 suspends the short-tail brake, so all five cut. This is the same shape as the twenty-miss run that sank me in batch 1, and block 11 repeats it with four ideology labels. Remaining stem-ends taken as free points from the dangling-stem law: @27 بموافقة (construct state awaiting its genitive, then ربع/نصف/ثلثي/غالبية الاعضاء), @66 في, @88 هي, @102 هي, @180 هو, @221 تكون. Two stem-ends are not function words but are fixed by the option run that follows: @133 صارمة (then القيود النقدية / القيود الكمية / الحظر الشامل / لا شيء مما سبق) and @194 مصر (then رئيس الجمهورية / وزارة الخارجية / مجلس الشعب / كل ما سبق ذكره صحيح). @252 والطمأنينة closes the last stem: that final و is bare-noun coordination inside إحساس الثقة والطمأنينة, so it does not cut, and the four ideology options follow. Result: 11 stems + 44 options = 55 units.
